Bindings.Binding: if NoteCraft and NoteCraft.MainWindow then NoteCraft.MainWindow:Toggle() end
if NoteCraft and NoteCraft.Minimap then NoteCraft.Minimap:Toggle() end
if NoteCraft and NoteCraft.Options then NoteCraft.Options:Open() end

if NoteCraft and NoteCraft.NoteDialog and UnitExists("target") and UnitIsPlayer("target") then local name, realm = UnitFullName("target") if name then if not realm or realm == "" then realm = GetNormalizedRealmName() or "" end NoteCraft.NoteDialog:Show(realm ~= "" and (name .. "-" .. realm) or name) end end
